method: Pairs use only events in apps/seerah-timeline/src/data/content.json. No new sources were added; every source is an existing sunnah.com link already attached to the events. Years are the conventional chart years in the data, not exact dates.
eligibility: Both events dated in the data (CE year, AH year or a stated period) and no disputed/debated note. Gap preference: at least one conventional year; same-year pairs only when the cited report fixes the order.

excluded.reason: Date note states the exact date is disputed.
Dated "date debated"; its relation to campaigns is debated.
Title contains the ordinal word "first", which would reveal the order in the question.
Title contains "after", a relational cue; length of the pause and CE date not established.
Title "Farewell" signals lateness and would make the question trivial.
Title signals the end of the sequence; the year is also only conventional.

excludedPairs.reason: Both 2 AH; the cited reports (Bukhari 399, 3953) do not fix the order between them, so the same-year rule fails.
Both 7 AH; Bukhari 4210 and 4251 do not fix the order between them.
Both 9 AH; Bukhari 4418 and 4655 do not fix the order between them.
Two reports of the same battle; no independent order.

excludedPairs.pair: events sharing one report (Khadija/Waraqa, Hudaybiyah details, Tabuk/Kab ibn Malik)
excludedPairs.reason: Sequence is within one report, not separately dated events; only arrival/mosque is used because Bukhari 428 narrates the order explicitly.
The Taif-region encounter has no year in its report (only "often associated" with the Taif journey); a gap under 2 years between two approximate placements is not secure enough.
0.9 conventional year apart in the data, under the one-year preference.
